description: React component for scheduling post options in Mattermost, including timezone-aware time formatting and menu options for scheduling posts at specific times.

methods.name: getScheduledTimeInTeammateTimezone
methods.description: Formats a timestamp in the teammate's timezone respecting the user's locale.

methods.name: getNextWeekday
methods.description: Calculates the date of the next specified weekday from a given DateTime.

methods.name: CoreMenuOptions
methods.description: React component rendering scheduling options for posts, including 'Tomorrow', 'Next Monday', and 'Monday' options, with timezone considerations.
